# Business Hustle
# https://businesshustle.co.za
# Last updated: 2026

> Business Hustle is a South African technology company. It builds websites, online directories, and AI automation for local businesses. It also trains young South Africans to work with AI. The company was founded by Tselakgosi Jacob Seatlholo. Business Hustle is a product of Simple Eternity Holdings (Pty) Ltd. The company follows the Batho Pele principle. Batho Pele means People First.

## What Business Hustle Does

### Websites and Directories
Business Hustle builds websites and online directories for local businesses. Example: KloofStreet.online. This is a directory of businesses on Kloof Street in Cape Town. The business keeps ownership of its information.

### AI Search Visibility
Business Hustle sets up business information so AI assistants like ChatGPT can find it and recommend it. When people ask AI for local services, listed businesses show up.

### Task Automation
Business Hustle uses AI to do repetitive office work. Examples: data entry, reports, and admin. A person checks every important step.

### AI Data Work
Business Hustle prepares and checks data used to train AI models. This work is called data curation and model evaluation.

### AI Training For Youth
Business Hustle trains young South Africans to work with AI.

## How Business Hustle Works

1. We Listen First. We study your business. We find where technology saves you the most time. We ask before we build.
2. We Build. We build with open source tools. We connect the new tools to the systems you already use. You own everything we build.
3. We Train Your Team. We show your team how to use the new tools. You are never locked into us.

## Industries Served

- Financial Services. AI tools for compliance and risk work.
- Healthcare. AI for bookings, patient messages, and practice admin.
- Mining and Energy. AI that warns about equipment problems before they stop work.
- Agriculture. Crop monitoring with cameras and AI.
- Retail and Online Stores. AI that predicts demand and keeps stock levels right.
- Logistics. Better delivery routes and full supply chain view.
- Public Sector. Systems that help government offices serve people faster.
- Education. Learning tools that adapt to each student.

## Our Own Live Products

- KloofStreet.online. A business directory for Kloof Street in Cape Town. Time Out ranks the street number 22 in the world. 50+ businesses listed.
- FundingStatsSA. A public dashboard that tracks development funding in South Africa. Every number is verified.
- OpenTender ZA. A public database of government tenders. It checks suppliers and shows trust ratings.
- PoliceData ZA. Official South African crime statistics on simple maps. Launched on Human Rights Day 2026.
- BlackBiz. A verified directory of Black businesses in South Africa. It includes a news feed and growth tools.
- MoveCape.online. A local platform that connects people with businesses and services in Cape Town.
- HustlePortal.online. A tool that runs business admin. Leads, clients, invoices, calendar, and reports in one place. Free to start.
